in_marathi.name: Satisha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Satisha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Satisha is derived from the Sanskrit word Satya, meaning 'truth'. In Hindu mythology, Satisha is an epithet for the Hindu goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and wisdom. The name is also associated with the planet Saturn, which is considered to be a symbol of truth and stability in Hindu astrology.
